data.body: B6 tiny-inline TDD exception: RED static oracle found exactly two stale bak-retarget references in tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_store_copy_isolation.py (exclusion entry and scrub comment). Removed both while preserving the observable .bridge_state* scrub. GREEN static oracle exits 1/no matches across src, .github, and fixture. Six live-Jira isolation tests collect under pytest. Defect-seeded mutation restored the exclusion entry and made the oracle detect line 47; restored intended code. Refactoring litmus passes because the oracle asserts only the externally forbidden deleted artifact name, not internal symbols. Inline strong-tier edit used because this was a one-line data deletion plus comment generalization; hold-out traded for mandatory mutation control.
